text:
Re-check of first-year value = after-tax cash + match + vested equity:

Pre-tax cash = salary + bonus. After-tax = pre-tax * (1-0.35) = pre-tax * 0.65.
Match = min(% * salary, cap), untaxed.
Vested equity by month 12 = grant * 12/48 = grant * 0.25.

North:
- Bonus = 10% * 155,000 = 15,500
- Pre-tax = 155,000 + 15,500 = 170,500
- After-tax = 170,500 * 0.65 = 110,825
- Match = 5% * 155,000 = 7,750; cap 20,000 => 7,750
- Vested = 80,000 * 12/48 = 20,000
- Total = 110,825 + 7,750 + 20,000 = 138,575

South:
- Bonus = 0% * 155,000 = 0
- Pre-tax = 155,000 + 0 = 155,000
- After-tax = 155,000 * 0.65 = 100,750
- Match = 6% * 155,000 = 9,300; cap 6,000 => 6,000
- Vested = 80,000 * 12/48 = 20,000
- Total = 100,750 + 6,000 + 20,000 = 126,750

138,575 > 126,750, so North is higher. No errors found.

{"choice": "North", "value": 138575}
